user.title: VDM10 intercom
user.description: Set up the VDM10 door intercom. Searching the network finds the outdoor station (doorbell) and the main indoor unit automatically.

discover.title: VDM10 discovery
discover.description: Devices found on the network. The registrar answer identifies the main indoor unit; outdoor stations report via SADP.

manual.title: VDM10 intercom
manual.description: Register Home Assistant as a room station on the VDM10 SIP registrar (the main indoor unit). Only its IP and the extension password are required - everything else is derived.

data.username: Extension number (empty = auto-detect next free, e.g. 10000000002)
data.door_host: Outdoor station (doorbell) IP (empty = auto-detect via network scan)
data.name: Display name (optional)
data.door_password: Door ISAPI/RTSP password (defaults to extension password)
data.preload_stream: Preload the camera stream (faster start, keeps the door streaming in standby)
data.provider: SIP provider (Linphone/PBX, optional - host/user/pass suffice, rest is derived)
data.sip_target: Ring target for incoming calls (empty = sip:<user>@<domain>, all account devices)
data.sip_domain: Provider domain in the REGISTER (empty = same as host)
data.inbound_target: Intercom extension to ring when called via SIP (empty = the main indoor station)
data.fritz_domain: Registrar domain in the fritz REGISTER
data.fritz_target: Number to ring on the fritzfon (e.g. **9)

error.cannot_bind: Address not on this host or port already in use
error.cannot_reach: Could not determine a local IP that reaches the registrar
error.cannot_detect_extension: Could not detect a free extension slot - enter the extension number manually (e.g. 10000000002)
error.cannot_detect_door: No outdoor station answered the network scan - enter its IP manually
error.nothing_found: No VDM10 devices answered - check the network or pick Manual.
error.docker_detected: Container networking detected - enter the host machine's LAN IP below; network scan is unavailable.
error.cannot_connect: No reply - check address/port and that this host can reach it
error.extension_conflict: This extension is already held by another device - pick a different number (e.g. the next free one)
error.register_rejected: The server rejected the registration - check port and settings

abort.not_main_indoor: This unit is not the main indoor station - the entry registers on the main indoor's SIP registrar, so only it is set up.
abort.closed: The configuration dialog was closed before this step finished.

init.title: VDM10 options
init.description: All settings from the initial setup, editable afterwards. Saving reloads the entry.

data.name: Display name
data.preload_stream: Preload the camera stream (faster start, keeps the door streaming in standby)
data.sip_target: Ring target for incoming calls (empty = all account devices)
data.inbound_target: Intercom extension to ring when called via SIP (empty = the main indoor station)
data.fritz_domain: Registrar domain in the fritz REGISTER
data.fritz_target: Number to ring on the fritzfon

answer_call.name: Answer call
answer_call.description: Answers the ringing VDM10 doorbell call (200 OK, audio established; mic stays muted until the talk control is used).

hangup_call.name: Hang up call
hangup_call.description: Declines the ringing call or hangs up the established call.
